violations.text: Working containers (spray bottles) used for storing chemicals taken from bulk supplies were not marked with the common name of the chemical. Spray bottles were labeled during the time of inspection. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 06/02/2026

Bowls (a pitcher with a missing handle) are being used as scoops in containers of flour. Utensils used to dispense non-time/temperature control for safety (TCS) foods such as sugar and flour must be stored in the food item with their handles above the top of the food within the container. Bowls were removed during the time of inspection. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 06/02/2026

The non-food contact surfaces of the walk-in cooler fan guards and ice machine have an accumulation of dust, dirt, food residue, and other debris. Non-food contact surfaces of equipment shall be cleaned at a frequency necessary to prevent the accumulation of dust, dirt, food residue, and other debris. New Violation. Correct By: 06/02/2026

The hand-washing sink in the kitchen was blocked by dirty dishes on the floor and linen basket. A hand-washing sink shall be accessible at all times for employee use. Dishes and linen basket were moved during time of inspection. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 03/20/2025

Packages of imitation crab meat were observed thawing in the walk-in cooler with intact reduced oxygen packaging (ROP). Seafood packaged in ROP shall be removed from original packaging prior to thawing to reintroduce oxygen into the food item. Food items were observed at 37 degrees Fahrenheit during time of inspection and were removed from packaging during time of inspection. New Violation. Correct By: 03/20/2025
